run_card_reproduction_gate.reason: Run-card values are rounded to four decimal places; all four must reproduce on the full corresponding fold before any E-513 cohort comparison is calculated.

scoring.mixing: float32 raw predictions blended in float64 arithmetic, cast to float32, then clipped by the official scorer
scoring.selection_tie_rule: maximum WP; among values within 1e-8 of maximum choose smallest lambda
scoring.analysis_unit: pure-chain validation group; bootstrap resamples complete connected chains

stop_rule: If row-group mapping, fold/ancestry checks, or any run-card score fails its gate, stop before scoring E-513 blends and preserve the failure as provenance evidence.
